Public static void wrapper discards the native-wrapper bool at IL_000D

discovery.onMismatch: Disable observer and report unavailable; no guessed overload or native fallback

observerDesign.counterMeaning: Observed normal method returns, not distinct players, final admissions or trusted-count acknowledgements
observerDesign.runOriginalOptional: Static loader review confirms support in local Harmony 2.3.1.1: a postfix requesting __runOriginal causes CreateReplacement to allocate/init the bool local, which EmitCallParameter reads. It does not exclude other transpilers, postfixes or detours. The minimum observer does not require this parameter.
observerDesign.threadHandling: Atomic counters/timestamps only, no Unity or Oxide calls, logs, IO, waiting or network
observerDesign.exceptions: Do not throw observer errors into the caller or suppress original exceptions; no false result is recorded for an exceptional original exit

normalThreadPath.operation: Subsequent Auth_EAC coroutine is scheduled after Auth_Steam finishes

threadLimit: Normal game path is Unity coroutine main-thread scheduling, but other plugin/runtime callers are not proven main-thread. Runtime thread identity has not been observed.
inliningLimit: No NoInlining marker is present. Body size and finally do not establish actual Mono JIT behavior. Late patch installation and existing compiled/inlined callers can make a zero count inconclusive.
otherPatchesLimit: Inspect known Harmony patches before/after install. Skipping prefixes, transpilers and postfix order may change the observed value. Patch enumeration cannot exclude all non-Harmony detours.
unloadDesign: Set an atomic stopping flag before removal
Unpatch only this exact postfix on this exact target
Do not globally unpatch or remove other owners
Verify no own patch remains; retain explicit cleanup failure state
Keep in-flight observer references safe and no-op after stopping
Unsubscribe existing events and destroy timers without blocking the game thread
runtimeVerificationStillRequired: Harmony target installation on the actual runtime
Observer firing for a genuine normal-client connection
Return categories versus separate Steam, EAC and final admission timeline
Reload/unload cleanup with no residual own patch
Independent public trusted-count observation; no causal connection is established by a bool alone
conclusion: The precise internal managed bool target is statically verified. This report is an observation design, not an installed observer or a trusted-player-count repair.
